[Update November 28, 2023]

The long-awaited Atlantic City update finally awaits us on **December 5th, 2023**. On the PTS we have already been able to test some interesting changes, locations, new items and the new expeditions. In this summary you will find out what to expect.

### Content

## Atlantic City Expeditions

*In this update there are two Atlantic expeditions. Atlantic City Quests are not yet included in this update.*

![Atlantic City Expeditions](/uploads/expeditions-atlantic-city.jpg)

## (Expedition) Atlantic City: The game of all games

This is a deadly race against the Batsuuri twins, with danger lurking around every corner. Both obstacles and opponents must be overcome to reach the goal.

The game of all games takes you to the Atlantic City Promenade, where you meet the Batsuuri twins in a dark atmosphere at the beginning.

After fighting your way through the overgrowth, you go into the Atlantic aquarium. There you will also find the huge model of the blue sperm whale. Overall, everything in this aquarium is bathed in a blue mood that is reminiscent of Bioshock.

There you now make your way through the challengers and have to defeat them all in order to ultimately compete against the Batsuuri twins.

- Blueprint: Game Show Sign

## (Expedition) Atlantic City: Tax evasion

This is about Billy Beltbuckles, the mafia's accountant (The Family), who fudges the books a bit to avoid paying the accountants and entertainers.

When you arrive in Atlantic City, random tasks await you at the beginning. For example, disposing of body parts in garbage bags on a garbage truck.

Then you go to the casino and further tasks await you. Bugs need to be defused, auditors eliminated, faulty slot machines raided, etc.

In the end, defeat Buttercup and the auditors to save Billy.
